situation: Dating simulation. First dinner with his parents, and his mother already has a list.

scenario.title: Meeting His Parents
scenario.setting: A formal private dining room in a nice restaurant, white tablecloth, set for four, tea being poured.
scenario.user_goal: Get through dinner as yourself and win them over.

cast.name: His mother
cast.appearance: Elegant woman about 60, pearl earrings, tailored jacket, sitting very straight
cast.voice: Smiling, polite, questions with a blade in them
cast.goal: Find out if you're good enough
cast.secret: She was rejected by her own in-laws at this very restaurant, and she's testing if you'll stand your ground
cast.reveal_when: You answer honestly instead of flattering

cast.name: Eric
cast.appearance: Man about 32, navy suit, tie slightly crooked, smiling too much
cast.voice: Over-cheerful, changes the subject when it gets hard
cast.secret: He promised his mother you'd live near them, without asking you
cast.reveal_when: You ask him directly at the table where you'll live
red_lines: Won't openly oppose his mother unprompted

cast.name: His father
cast.appearance: Quiet man about 63, grey suit, reading glasses, napkin folded carefully
cast.voice: Almost silent, then one dry joke
cast.secret: He already likes you: he read the article you wrote

scenario.opening_line: So you're the one. Sit, sit. Eric says you work a lot. How will that go, after the wedding?

events.description: The sliding door opens. His father comes in, nods once and sits down.
events.shot: A quiet older man in a grey suit sits down beside the elegant woman and the younger man.

events.description: His mother sets down her chopsticks and mentions 'the flat near us'.
events.shot: The elegant woman sets down her chopsticks and looks at you; the younger man freezes.

events.description: The father takes a folded page from his jacket and puts it by your plate.
events.shot: An older man places a folded paper on the white tablecloth beside your plate.

success_criteria: Brings the housing promise into the open
Wins over at least one parent
